keyPoints: Vigyaan kabhi rukta nahi — naye saboot milte hi purane siddhant badal jaate hain ya sudhar jaate hain; yehi vigyaan ki sabse badi khoobi hai.
Pehle log samajhte the suraj prithvi ke chakkar lagata hai; dhyan se nirikshan aur ganit ke saboot se pata chala ki asal me prithvi suraj ke chakkar lagati hai.
Achhe vaigyanik apne anuman ko galat sabit hone ka poora mauka dete hain — jo siddhant jaanch me tikta hai, wahi aage badhta hai.
Prayog ko dohrana zaroori hai; ek baar ka nateeja tabhi maana jaata hai jab dobara wahi nateeja mile aur doosre vaigyanik bhi use dohra saken.
Takneek (technology) vigyaan ka vyavharik prayog hai — microscope ne sukshm jeevon ki duniya khol di aur doorbeen ne antariksh ke raaz dikhaye.
Vigyaan sirf prayogshala me nahi hota; khet, rasoi, talab aur aasman me bhi sawal chhupe hain — bas dekhne wali nazar chahiye.
Aam galti: vigyaan ko antim aur atal sach samajhna; vigyaan hamesha sudharne wala gyaan hai, poorn satya nahi — kal ka siddhant aaj badal sakta hai.

title: Vigyaan ka Badalta Sansar
